en: Summon Squire
Use the manual to call your Argent Squire for a training lesson in combat with the Silithid. Silithids killed in the squire's presence will increase your reputation with the Argent Dawn.
Your squire is accompanying you. Gaining Argent Dawn reputation for killing Silithids.
Horn of the Dawn

Rally your nearby party or raid members, granting them $s1% increased spell critical strike chance, $s3% increased melee and ranged critical strike chance, and $s2 increased attack power. Lasts $d. Exclusive with similar world effects and unaffected by Chronoboons.
Increases critical chance of spells by $s1%, melee and ranged by $s3% and grants $s2 attack power.
Songflower Lullaby

Summon a songflower that grants all your party or raid members $s1% increased chance for a melee, ranged, or spell critical by and $s2 increased attributes by for $d. Exclusive with similar world effects. Unaffected by Chronoboons.
Increases chance for a melee, ranged, or spell critical by $s1% and all attributes by $s2.
Blessing of Neptulon

Grants all your nearby party or raid members $s1 increased attack power, $s3% increased Stamina, and $s4% increased spell critical strike chance for $d. Exclusive with similar world effects. Unaffected by Chronoboons.
Increases attack power by $s1, Stamina by $s3%, and spell critical strike chance by $s4%.
Might of Blackrock
Increases hitpoints by $s1. $s2% haste to melee attacks. $s3 mana regen every 5 seconds.
Increases hitpoints by $s1. $s2% haste to melee attacks. $s3 mana regen every 5 seconds.
Dark Fortune of Damage
Grants all your party or raid members $s1% increased damage done for $d.
Increases damage by $s1%.
Firewater Cauldron
Summon a cauldron of Firewater for $d, useable by all members of your party or raid to increase melee attack power by $473469s1 and size for $473469d.
Cleansed Firewater
Increases your melee attack power by $s1 and size for $d.
Increases size, and melee attack power by $s1.
Dreams of Zandalar
Grants all your party or raid members $s1% increased movement speed and $s3% increased stats for $d.
Increases movement speed by $s1% and all stats by $s3%.
Songflower Serenade
Elemental Disjunction
Weakens Elemental members of the Abyssal Council in Silithus, reducing all damage they deal by $s1%. Lasts $d.
Damage done decreased by $s1%.
Explosive Sand Trap

Place a trap at a nearby location that explodes when a Silithid from Hive'Ashi, Hive'Regal, or Hive'Zora approaches, causing the Silithid to take $473496s1% of its health in damage every $473496t sec for $473496d.
Explosive Sand Trap
Taking $s1% of health in Fire damage every $t1 seconds.
Freez-O-Matic Ray
Freezes a Silithid within the Hive'Ashi, Hive'Regal, or Hive'Zora hives for $d. Effect broken by any damage.
Sneaking
Inhaling this incense causes you to fade into the shadows, allowing you to sneak around while inside Hive'Ashi, Hive'Regal, or Hive'Zora, but reduces your speed by $s2%.  Lasts $d.
Stealthed.  Movement slowed by $s2%.
Lasso

Throw the ancient rope to restrain a silithid of Hive'Ashi, Hive'Regal, or Hive'Zora and pull them toward you. May not be used on enemies higher than level ${$PL+1} or which are marked as boss enemies.
Lasso
Lasso
Immune to Stun.
Argent Dawn
Argent Dawn
While an argent squire is present in your party or raid, killing silithids in Hive'Ashi, Hive'Regal, and Hive'Zora grants reputation with the Argent Dawn.
Combat Training
Taunt
Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.
Taunted.

Summon Tamed Silithid Tank

Emits a high frequency sound, forcing a silithid tank to burrow out from its home beneath the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. The silithid is obedient to the summoner and can be used as a mount within the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. Any hostile action towards the rider forces the tank underground.
